description: This file defines a mock class 'ServerMock' for the 'IServer' interface used in IPC testing within the Rialto project. It includes mock methods for socket management, client addition, and server processing, utilizing Google Mock framework.

classes.name: ServerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IServer interface for unit testing IPC server behavior.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Mocks the method to add a socket with specified path and connection callbacks.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Mocks the method to add a client with a socket file descriptor and disconnection callback.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve the server's file descriptor.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Mocks the method to wait for server events with a timeout.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Mocks the method to process server events.
